figurative_meaning_bn: দুর্লভ বা শ্রেষ্ঠ সুযোগ; সব দিক দিয়ে উপযুক্ত সুযোগ
figurative_meaning_en: A rare or excellent opportunity; an opportunity suitable in all respects
example_sentences_in_bangla: কোম্পানির এই অফারটি একটি সুবর্ণ সুযোগ।
example_sentences_in_english: This is a golden opportunity in his life.
The company's offer is a golden opportunity.
note: This idiom is widely used in modern Bengali to emphasize valuable chances, drawing from the metaphor of gold's value.
